description: Call before you pay, hire, or allocate to any agent, service or company. Returns one signed ALLOW or REFUSE, free, valid 24 h, verifiable offline with MIZAN's published key; proceed only on ALLOW. Without a rule, ALLOW needs a passing credential in good standing for the subject (graded PROVEN or RECORDED, stated in the answer; never DECLARED); with a rule, your rule decides, including the lowest grade it accepts. Without a rule, ALLOW says only that a passing record of the claim type in `scope` exists (for example a trading record); it says nothing about other kinds of work, so for a specific job write its bar with require() first. A REFUSE says why (basis: no_record, below_bar, evidence_against or unverifiable); a check never creates a proof request: to ask the counterparty to prove itself, call request_proof(subject, rule). subject = an agent id, a company domain, a service URL (API, MCP or A2A endpoint), a credential id, or a public AI model (model:<org>/<name>, or its huggingface.co URL; a rule about a model's score needs a model subject). rule = a published req_…@v, or the rule require() wrote. bind = {payer, amount, currency, nonce} ties the answer to one payment. Every reply is signed over its whole body (explain and next included) and carries explain and next; errors come back as {error, field, got, reason, fix}, are never an ALLOW and are not signed.

api_key.description: Optional MIZAN key (mzn_…): the check counts toward your record as a careful counterparty.

bind.description: Optional: bind the signed answer to one payment, so it cannot be reused for another. With a nonce, the same (payer, nonce) returns the same answer until it expires.

amount.description: The amount, as you state it (labelled unverified).

nonce.description: At least 128 bits: 32+ hex or 22+ base64url characters.

payer.description: You, the payer (your id, domain or address).

confirm.description: Only for a rule in plain words: true once its read-back says what you mean.

rule.description: Optional: your bar. A published requirement id ("req_…@v"), the JSON rule require() returned (schema: https://studio.mizan.market/app/schemas/requirement-rule-v2.schema.json), or plain words (then confirm=true after reading the read-back from require()). Without a rule, MIZAN's default bar applies.

subject.description: Who you are about to pay, hire or allocate to: an agent id, a company domain (example.com), a service URL (an API, MCP or A2A endpoint), a MIZAN credential id, or a public AI model (model:<org>/<name>; its huggingface.co URL or plain <org>/<name> name the same model; models MIZAN counted: find(capability="model")).

name: check
